generated_sql:
/* --------------------------------------------------------------
   Profit‑margin per product category
   --------------------------------------------------------------
   profit_margin = (total profit) / (total revenue) * 100
   where
       total revenue = Σ (order_quantity * sale_price)
       total profit   = Σ (order_quantity * (sale_price – cost_price))
   -------------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT
    c.CategoryName,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE
                (SUM(od.Quantity * (od.UnitPrice - p.CostPrice)) * 100.0) /
                SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice)
        END,
        2
    ) AS ProfitMargin_Percent
FROM
    OrderDetails AS od                -- line items of each order
    JOIN Products   AS p   ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID
    JOIN Categories AS c   ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID
GROUP BY
    c.CategoryID, c.CategoryName
ORDER BY
    ProfitMargin_Percent DESC;        -- highest‑margin categories first

question: What is the return rate for each product category?

WITH total AS (
    SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category,
           COUNT(*) AS total_items
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o          ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t 
                           ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered','canceled')
    GROUP BY category
),
canceled AS (
    SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category,
           COUNT(*) AS canceled_items
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o          ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t 
                           ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled'
    GROUP BY category
)
SELECT t.category,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c.canceled_items,0) * 1.0 / t.total_items, 4) AS return_rate
FROM total t
LEFT JOIN canceled c ON t.category = c.category
ORDER BY return_rate DESC;
